name: io.github.wttech/acm-mcp-server
title: AEM Content Manager (ACM)
description: Validate and run Groovy scripts on Adobe Experience Manager through AEM Content Manager (ACM).

environmentVariables.name: AEM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: AEM author URL, e.g. https://author-pXXXX-eYYYY.adobeaemcloud.com or http://localhost:4502

environmentVariables.name: AEM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, e.g. an AEMaaCS local development token from the Developer Console

environmentVariables.name: AEM_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Value of the AEM login-token cookie from a browser session

environmentVariables.name: AEM_COOKIE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the login-token value, re-read on every request

environmentVariables.name: AEM_USER
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth user, for a local AEM SDK

environmentVariables.name: AEM_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth password, for a local AEM SDK

environmentVariables.name: ACM_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to block the tools that run code. A guardrail against accidental runs, not a security boundary
